title: Construction Bids: Why Google Ads Rarely Reach Public Owners

facts.fact: In the vendor's example market of Cincinnati, 116 readable Search ads from 19 builders, specialty trades and remodelers were reviewed, and none used the word "bid."
facts.quote: Chapter 8 read the 116 readable ads from 19 builders, specialty trades and remodelers. None of them used the word "bid."

facts.fact: The vendor collected Search ads run by construction websites in Cincinnati between August 1 and October 30, 2026, using Google's Ads Transparency Center.
facts.quote: Chapter 7 collected the Search ads that construction websites in the example market, Cincinnati, ran between August 1 and October 30, 2026, using Google's Ads Transparency Center.

facts.fact: The Blue Book construction directory's ads, run by its parent company Dodge, numbered 15, and 9 of them used "bid" or "bidding."
facts.quote: Its parent company, Dodge, ran all 15 of them, and 9 used "bid" or "bidding."

facts.fact: Per Google Keyword Planner across the US, the phrase "construction bids" (grouped with "construction bidding") gets about 1,000 searches a month.
facts.quote: "Construction bids" (with "construction bidding," which Google groups with it): about 1,000 searches a month.

facts.fact: Per Google Keyword Planner across the US, "construction bid sites" gets about 590 searches a month.
Per Google Keyword Planner across the US, "bid opportunities" gets about 590 searches a month.
Per Google Keyword Planner across the US, "government construction bids" gets about 90 searches a month.
facts.quote: "Government construction bids" and "commercial construction bids": about 90 each.

facts.fact: Per Google Keyword Planner across the US, "public works bids" gets about 40 searches a month.
facts.quote: "Public works bids" and "construction bid opportunities": about 40 each.

facts.fact: New York's procurement law defines a "restricted period" that runs from the earliest posting of a solicitation to the final contract award.
facts.quote: New York's procurement law, for instance, defines a "restricted period" that runs from the earliest posting of a solicitation to the final contract award.

facts.fact: A section heading in the chunk states that design-bid-build was 19% of construction spending in one industry study and is shrinking.
facts.quote: Design-Bid-Build Was 19% of Construction Spending in One Industry Study, and It's Shrinking

facts.fact: In a FMI study prepared for the Design-Build Institute of America, design-bid-build was 19% of construction put in place in the building and infrastructure segments studied from 2019 to 2023.
facts.quote: design-bid-build, the classic low-bid method, was 19% of construction put in place from 2019 to 2023

facts.fact: FMI's forecast for 2024 to 2028 puts design-bid-build at 11% of construction put in place in the segments it studied.
facts.quote: FMI's forecast for 2024 to 2028 puts it at 11%

facts.fact: In the FMI study's segments, design-build was 44% of construction put in place from 2019 to 2023.
facts.quote: Design-build was 44% and is forecast at 47%.

facts.fact: In the FMI study, other alternative delivery methods such as construction management at risk were 37% of construction put in place from 2019 to 2023.
facts.quote: Other alternative methods, such as construction management at risk, were 37% and are forecast at 42%.

facts.fact: The building and infrastructure segments FMI studied account for about half of all US construction spending.
facts.quote: about half of all US construction spending

facts.fact: Miami-Dade's procurement Cone of Silence prohibits any communication regarding a particular RFP, RFQ or bid solicitation after it has been advertised.
facts.quote: Cone of Silence prohibits any communication regarding a particular RFP, RFQ or bid solicitation after they have been advertised,

facts.fact: Miami-Dade's procurement page states that written communications copied to the Clerk of the Board are permitted at all times during a bid solicitation.
facts.quote: Written communications, copied to the Clerk of the Board, are permitted at all times.

facts.fact: New York State Finance Law 139-j restricts contacts between bidders and the agency during a restricted period and a related section requires every contact in that period to be recorded.
facts.quote: and a related section requires every contact in that period to be recorded.
